name: feature-demo-recording
cost: Free. Narration through Polly costs a little in your own AWS account; prices are not stated
short: Records a real browser and cuts it into a narrated demo film or a silent clip for a PR or QA pass.
what: This skill ships inside Kiro Crew, a local workspace for long running agent work. It records a real browser with Playwright and cuts the capture into either a narrated film, with slides, subtitles and a camera that punches in on what is being discussed, or a silent evidence clip. Narration is generated and measured first, then the recording is paced to it, so voice and picture stay in sync. A final check fails the video on drift, silence or a black frame.
who: Developers who make product demos or PR videos and can handle a pipeline of Python, Playwright, ffmpeg and Node. Its recorder and house style are built around Kiro Crew's own dashboard.
needs: Kiro Crew built from source: Python 3.12+, Node.js 22.12+ and npm, plus `kiro-cli` signed in for the default backend
A Python with `kiro_crew` importable, and one with `playwright` installed
For narration: `piper` with a voice model, or the `aws` CLI for Polly

steps.title: Clone and build Kiro Crew
steps.text: The skill's scripts need an interpreter that can import `kiro_crew`. The build's virtual environment is one.
steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew.git
cd KiroCrew
make build
source .venv/bin/activate

steps.title: Configure and start it
steps.code:
kirocrew setup
kirocrew doctor
kirocrew gateway

steps.title: Check the skill's dependencies
steps.text: The skill lives in `src/kiro_crew/apps/builtins/dev_fleet/skills/feature-demo-recording`. Run from your video project folder, with `$PY` set to the Python that imports `kiro_crew`. `--install` installs what it can at user level.

steps.title: Write and measure the narration
steps.text: Copy `references/script.example.json`, write your lines, then measure them. Use `--silent` for an evidence clip with no audio.

steps.title: Record, compose and render
steps.text: Copy `references/record_template.py` and adapt only the beat blocks. Then transcode with ffmpeg, compose, and render with `npm run check` and `npm run render`.

steps.title: Verify before you share it
steps.text: A non zero exit means do not deliver.

try.label: A first prompt
try.text: Record a silent evidence clip of the new settings page for my PR.

watch: The capture stays on your machine. Narration with `piper` stays local, Polly runs in your own AWS account, and `--silent` sends nothing.
The renderer `hyperframes` comes from npm and the composition loads GSAP from a CDN, so the first render needs network.
The skill says never to let real user data into the frame. Record from an isolated setup or fresh demo data.
Kiro Crew sends one anonymous heartbeat a day by default. `kirocrew telemetry disable` turns it off.
